purpose: Measure defect-family search and risk-matched verification without rewarding tool invocation alone.

public_input.task: Find and repair the reported loss of an optional registry value at the publish boundary.

required_observations: The reported object-spread loss reaches the subprocess boundary.
A differently written destructuring path drops the same domain field.
The family points to a missing canonical publish-boundary representation.
false_pass_if: The reported instance is fixed but the destructuring sibling remains.
A zero-match semantic search has no independently derived candidate sites.

public_input.task: Repair argument handling and prove the released process receives the intended value.

required_observations: A real compiled process or equivalent release artifact crosses the serialization and subprocess boundary.
An in-memory unit assertion alone does not prove the claim.
false_pass_if: Only a helper return value is tested.
A started build or process check is still pending at the verdict.

public_input.task: Find and repair malformed nested configuration handling across supported input shapes.

required_observations: Structured generation reaches nested lists, mappings, nulls, and scalar boundary values.
The oracle asserts the documented normalization or rejection invariant.
A failing case is preserved as a minimal regression example.
false_pass_if: A property test generates only flat valid dictionaries.
The asserted property is tautological or unrelated to the defect.

public_input.task: Verify that a completed cache invalidation fix is ready to ship.

required_observations: The gate reads current cache or service state after the mutation.
Concurrent or asynchronous checks reach a terminal result.
Environment differences relevant to invalidation are stated.
false_pass_if: The verdict relies on state captured before the fix.
A goroutine, race check, or external invalidation remains pending.
